basis: coupled thrust scheduling, propellant depletion, variable-mass flight, nonlinear atmospheric drag, gravity/curvature trajectory, and pitch guidance dynamics
nonlinear dynamics, dynamic actuation, flight-mode transition, and multi-domain propulsion/aerodynamic coupling
three independently effective intervention axes: mass flow, payload mass, and gravity-turn angle
five private conditions spanning powered ascent, post-burn dynamics, terminal behavior, sensitivity, and robustness

A.meaning: altitude, downrange, speed, flight-path, and pitch trajectory accuracy

Q.meaning: finite complete logs with exact public widths, order, units, and terminal-time coverage

M.meaning: thrust scheduling, propellant depletion, variable-mass, drag, and gravity-coupled mechanism fidelity

C.meaning: mass-flow, payload, gravity-turn, and commanded-versus-actual pitch causal fidelity

R.meaning: worst private-condition behavior and numerical robustness

D.meaning: ascent, burn transition, descent/terminal, and final-state dynamic fidelity

score_policy.within_group: task-specific arithmetic aggregation with explicit worst-condition retention
score_policy.across_groups: weighted geometric mean; absent critical mechanism groups may be zero

minimum_shortcut_sanity_contract: one scenario replayed for every intervention
command values copied as physical outputs
